description: Send a prompt to Grok through either the supported xAI Responses API or Grok Build's headless CLI (default harness: xai-api; default API model: grok-4.7; CLI default: grok-4.7; reasoning effort: high). Requires XAI_API_KEY and can incur xAI API charges. Ask LLM never enables billing, priority processing, credits, overage, model substitution, or fallback. Returns the actual provider/model and usage through the standard structured AskResponse.

harness.description: Execution harness, kept separate from the Grok model selection: xai-api or grok-cli. Defaults to xai-api; no harness fallback is attempted.

model.description: Exact model ID understood by the selected harness. Do not set unless the user explicitly requests one. Defaults to grok-4.7 on xai-api or grok-4.7 on grok-cli; Ask LLM never rewrites or falls back from the requested model.

prompt.description: The question, code review request, or analysis task to send to Grok through the selected harness

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning depth: low, medium, high, xhigh. Defaults to high; this is a request parameter, not a model-name suffix.

name: ask-grok
